correctness.rationale: Four homogeneous coordinates give y²=2v∧w+w∧w and y³=0. For each nonzero top-degree target, the Pfaffian orbit has q²(q³-1) bivectors and the wedge map is invertible; for each nonzero cubic-only target, exactly q³-1 rank-two bivectors lie in its support hyperplane, with q² vectors per bivector. The zero count includes all rank-two bivectors and w=0. Free higher coordinates multiply by q⁵; nonzero scalar branches lift uniquely for each of two scalar roots. Full q=3 exhaustive test and q=2 test agree with the symbolic proof.

value.rationale: The fixed-target square-root distribution is a natural complete invariant of a canonical noncommutative local algebra. It proves equidistribution over all nonzero nilpotent targets despite qualitatively different rank-two and rank-four preimage geometries. This cannot be recovered from known total-zero or regular-Jordan stratum tables, and the exact odd/characteristic-two contrast gives a structural boundary.
